newsitem.title: UK: European bunkers firmer recover Monday's losses.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers firmer recover Monday's losses.

text.p: European bunker fuel oil prices were mostly firmer on Tuesday recovering Monday's losses on the back of firmer crude, brokers said.
NWE markets were sold lower on Monday with little buying interest after most players covered requirements last week.

Prices in Rotterdam eased around $5 a tonne for heavy fuel oils although diesels and gas oil were more stable. Markets in Antwerp and Hamburg were similarly thin and prices weaker but gains on crude and gas oil futures in early Tuesday trade saw levels recovering at most ports.
Prices at Mideast Gulf ports continued bolstered by active cargo trade to the Far East. Fujairah sellers asked between $113-115 for heavy fuel and $121123 for light grades.
South African markets were mostly steady with Durban 180 cst bunkers holding $120 and with diesel and gas oil at a premiums of around $20 and $30 respectively.
Mediterranean markets showed similar price tendencies but traders said small pockets of demand were supportive.
